reason: A Windows-focused file-link enhancement that makes absolute paths in replies clickable, openable, previewable, and revealable in Explorer.

summaries.zh: 将回复中的绝对文件路径转换为可点击链接，支持打开文件、预览文本或图片以及在 Windows Explorer 中定位文件。
summaries.en: Turns absolute file paths in replies into clickable links for opening files, previewing text or images, and revealing them in Windows Explorer.

capabilities: Detects absolute file paths in replies and turns them into clickable links
Opens files with the system default application
Reads text and image files for inline preview with a stated 512 KB cap
Reveals files or directories in Windows Explorer
Adds client-side context-menu and preview-panel interactions
